title: David Jay Brown's field guide to DMT entities: machine elves and insectoid surgeons

tellings.quote: you know, to describe and there's a book by David J. Brown, illustrated field guide to DMT entities,

plain: People who take DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, often report meeting beings, from what the writer Terence McKenna called "machine elves" to insect-like creatures that seem to operate on them. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who studies the drug, mentions to Michels a book that catalogues these beings, the Illustrated Field Guide to DMT Entities by David Jay Brown, as a way of showing how consistent the reports are.
